nodes.name: 📡 Telegram Trigger
nodes.notes: Receives ALL admin messages including text, photo, video, document, audio

nodes.name: 📋 Read Session Tab
nodes.notes: Reads the Session tab to find the admin's current broadcast state

parameters.text:
📢 *Kamilight Broadcast System*

Who should receive this message?

Select a segment below:

❓ I didn't understand that.

Please tap one of the buttons or type a number:
1 — Major Clients
2 — Existing Clients
3 — Potential Clients
4 — Past Clients
5 — ALL Contacts

nodes.name: 💾 Update Session — segment + awaiting_content
nodes.notes: Update the row where admin_chat_id matches — sets step to awaiting_content

parameters.text:
✅ Segment: *{{ $json.selectedSegment === 'all' ? '🌍 ALL CONTACTS' : $json.selectedSegment.toUpperCase() }}*

📎 *Now send your broadcast content.*

You can send:
• 📝 A text message
• 🖼️ An image or flyer _(with or without caption)_
• 🎥 A video _(with or without caption)_
• 📄 A document or PDF _(with or without caption)_
• 🎤 A voice note or audio

_Send it now ↓_

nodes.name: 🔢 Count Contacts in Segment
nodes.notes: In n8n: add a Google Sheets getAll node named '📋 Read ALL Contacts — Count' before this node

parameters.text:
📋 *Broadcast Preview*
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🎯 Segment: *{{ $json.selectedSegment === 'all' ? '🌍 ALL CONTACTS' : $json.selectedSegment.toUpperCase() }}*
👥 Recipients: *{{ $json.matchCount }} contacts*

{{ $json.previewLine }}
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

*Ready to broadcast?*

❌ Broadcast cancelled.

Send any message to start a new broadcast.

nodes.name: 📊 Fetch ALL Contacts Fresh
nodes.notes: Always fresh. Every broadcast reads the latest data from the sheet.

parameters.text:
⚠️ No contactable contacts found for segment: *{{ $json.segment }}*

Check the Contacts sheet and verify tags.

Send any message to try again.

🚀 *Broadcast started!*

Sending to *{{ $input.all().length }} contacts*...
_You will receive a summary when done._

nodes.name: ⏱ Rate Limit Delay (1s per message)
nodes.notes: Prevents WhatsApp rate limiting. Increase to 2s if issues arise.

nodes.name: 📥 Get Telegram File Path (Photo)
nodes.notes: Replace YOUR_BOT_TOKEN. Gets the download path for the image.

nodes.name: ☁️ Upload to WhatsApp Media API
nodes.notes: Returns {id: 'MEDIA_ID'}. Store this for the send step.

nodes.name: 🖼️ Send WhatsApp IMAGE
nodes.notes: Upload once, reuse media_id for all contacts to avoid re-uploading same file

nodes.name: 🎥 Send WhatsApp VIDEO
nodes.notes: Same 3-step flow as photo: getFile → download → upload to WA → send. See media-send-guide.md

value.Caption/Message: ={{ $('🎯 Filter by Segment + Validate Phones').item.json.mediaCaption || $('🎯 Filter by Segment + Validate Phones').item.json.contentText || '' }}

nodes.name: ✅ Final Summary to Admin

parameters.text:
✅ *Broadcast Complete!*
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

📤 Total sent: *{{ $('🎯 Filter by Segment + Validate Phones').all().length }} contacts*
📎 Format: *{{ $('🎯 Filter by Segment + Validate Phones').first().json.contentType }}*
🕐 *{{ new Date().toLocaleString('en-NG', {timeZone: 'Africa/Lagos'}) }}*
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
